title: Food Microbiology RBP Prioritization and Magnetic Bioseparation Workflow
description: Version 1.1.0 preserves the historical 827-record RBP prioritization and adds the version 0.4.0 input/evidence extension, exact-sequence identity audit (744 unique sequences), five full-pool missing-evidence scenarios, an external intake/abstention case and independently structured ELISA derivatives. The associated manuscript connects application-oriented candidate decisions to a preliminary Gp17 recognition and magnetic-capture case. This release does not establish predictive superiority, complete end-to-end prediction for new phages, or physiological receptor assignment. The same 24 extension tests previously passed in local and portable copies. No new wet experiments are introduced.
